findings.evidenceJa: がちゃん、と背中を玄関で強打する
findings.governingReading: he strikes his back hard against the entrance with a crash
findings.explanation: mirror moon reduces a forceful, noisy impact to a bump.

findings.highlight: Where were you for the extra two hours
findings.evidenceJa: 何処であぶらを売ってた
findings.governingReading: where he had been idling or wasting time for two hours
findings.explanation: Sakura’s accusatory idiom disappears into a neutral location question.

findings.highlight: I agreed with your decision to go to school
findings.evidenceJa: 学校に向かうという貴方の意見に従いました
findings.governingReading: Saber followed Shirou’s position that he should go to school
findings.explanation: Compliance with her Master’s position becomes agreement with a settled decision.

findings.highlight: I cannot forgive you this time
findings.evidenceJa: 今回は見逃す訳にはいきません
findings.governingReading: she cannot let this instance pass
findings.explanation: A practical refusal to overlook dangerous conduct becomes moral unforgiveness.

findings.highlight: It seems you are healthy enough
findings.evidenceJa: それほど元気だというのなら結構です
findings.governingReading: if Shirou claims to be that energetic, then very well
findings.explanation: Saber’s conditional, sarcastic acceptance becomes her own health assessment.

findings.highlight: I heard how good Saber-san is from Fujimura-sensei
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーさんの腕前は聞いています
findings.governingReading: Sakura has heard about Saber’s skill
findings.explanation: mirror moon invents Taiga as the source of Sakura’s information.

findings.highlight: I’ll only add fuel to the fire
findings.governingReading: oil on fire, coins before a cat: Shirou’s panicked collision of two proverbs
findings.explanation: mirror moon deletes the deliberately mangled cat-and-coins half of Shirou’s verbal panic.

findings.highlight: The two retreat together in unison
findings.evidenceJa: ずんずんと廊下を引き上げていく
findings.governingReading: the oddly synchronized pair stride forcefully away up the hallway
findings.explanation: mirror moon turns their determined march toward the dojo into a retreat.

findings.highlight: I guess I have to atone for my actions in the dojo
findings.evidenceJa: 二人の言う通り道場でしごかれるしかない
findings.governingReading: he has no choice but to submit to harsh drilling in the dojo as they ordered
findings.explanation: The concrete prospective punishment becomes abstract atonement, omitting that the training has not yet occurred.
